title: Expand lint_no_fallback.py to catch more silent-default patterns
description:
The custom lint script scripts/checks/lint_no_fallback.py currently catches `or []`, `or {}`, `or ""`. The fail-fast philosophy in AGENTS.md applies more broadly. Additional patterns to detect:

- dict.get(key, default_value) where the default hides a missing key (distinguish from legitimate use with None/sentinel checks)
- getattr(obj, attr, default) with a non-None fallback
- bare `except:` or `except Exception: pass` patterns (partially covered by BLE001 but not all shapes)

The dict.get case is the trickiest since dict.get() is legitimate when you genuinely want a default. The lint could flag .get() calls with a non-None second argument and require an inline comment to suppress.
